Core Active Vocabulary (8 items):

menu — the list of dishes in a restaurant. Example: The waiter brings the menu.
starter — a small dish before the main course. Example: I order soup as a starter.
main course — the largest dish of a meal. Example: Chicken is my main course.
dessert — sweet food at the end of a meal. Example: The dessert is apple pie.
table — furniture with a flat top and legs. Example: A table for two, please.
waiter — a person who serves food. Example: The waiter brings the bill.
dish — food prepared in a particular way. Example: My favourite dish is spicy chicken.
bill — the paper showing what you must pay. Example: Could we have the bill, please?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Are you ready to order?
• I'd like the ..., please.
• What is the dish of the day?
• A table for two, please.
• Could we have the bill?
